# Module 10 — nested and inner classes

Allowed: modules 1–9, plus static nested classes, inner classes, local classes, and anonymous classes.

Do not suggest or require: collections, regular expressions, lambda expressions, method references, `Optional`, the Date-Time API, the Stream API, threads, files, or web APIs.

An anonymous class is the tool for this module. Do not ask to turn it into a lambda. Exceptions from module 9 are allowed; do not ask to add them unless the task needs them.
